description.value: Earl Grey Lodge is a chalet-style bed and breakfast in the heart of Panorama Mountain Village, voted #1 small hotel in Canada by TripAdvisor in 2021. The 8,000 sq ft lodge sleeps up to 12 adults across six guest rooms and a separate two-bedroom cabin with a full kitchen, all decorated with rustic log walls and an art-deco interior. Situated steps from the ski slopes and surrounded by Purcell Mountain trails used for hiking and mountain biking, it makes a comfortable base for cyclists exploring the Columbia Valley.
